originalPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production web illustration for Ikkyee, a calm Korean travel-photo place archive. Create one polished landscape 3:2 transparent-background cutout illustration, not a screenshot and not a whole webpage. Show a simplified miniature map of Seoul as a thin ivory map slab viewed obliquely from the side and above, a graceful 30-degree isometric tilt. A softly blue-green Han River crosses the map with a couple of understated bridges, simplified pale road lines and low city blocks. A few clearly separated miniature 3D landmarks, including Namsan with N Seoul Tower and a quiet traditional palace roof, give a subtle architectural model feeling without clutter. The map is mostly flat and clean, with occasional raised trees/hills/landmarks. Place exactly three ordinary teardrop location pins, NOT leaves, at separated locations. Above each pin floats a small clean white framed travel photograph card, oriented upright toward the viewer; one larger foreground card is the focal point, showing a realistic Seoul travel scene with tower or river, and two smaller cards show a palace and city/river scenery. Cards, stems and pins visibly correspond to their own map position. The map and the three photo pins form one cohesive scene. Refined soft clay-and-paper 3D rendering, carefully crafted edges, gentle daylight and subtle ambient shadows. Palette matches warm ivory #f9f7f2, white, muted sage greens, restrained deep teal #1a4d4e accents, low-saturation blue-green water; no dark heavy base. Entire map slab, pins and photo cards fully visible with comfortable transparent margins on every side, the scene fills about 88% of the canvas, no clipping. No text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no map controls, no Google branding, no watermarks, no logos, no people portraits, no extra floating UI. This is an original illustrative Seoul-inspired map, not a cartographic/navigation product.
